description: I want you to personally deliver the news of Kovic's defeat to Vizzklick in Gadgetzan. He will be so happy to hear that Kovic is dead that I'm certain he'll give you some grand reward.
completion: Kovic slain??! This is a glorious day, <name>! For years that scoundrel has been running shady undermarket trades, undercutting honest, hard working traders all over the world.
You deserve a fine reward for this accomplishment! And a fine reward you shall have!
